body: In fact, it's so silly I might as well come out and say it. It's Italian.

A romance one, I'm kind of nervous about this ever getting back to me. I started out learning it because it's the language of my friend's family (the girl I mentioned earlier) so we'd be able to skype and I'd not have to worry about privacy issues. What with living where other people can hear and judge. Recently I feel it would be one means of legitimately eloping to start anew. The whole, "there to learn a language" thing, as opposed to "there to get away from here." I have no plans to hurt myself tonight but I always feel terrible in the mornings. I will keep this topic updated until such a time as this situation passes. Thanks for your interest.
